title: Sea renity Now! Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: "Sea-renity Now!" is a 3 bedroom/2.5 bath townhome just minute's from the beach in the heart of Gulf Place! Private gated beach access is just footsteps away with the main pool and tennis courts close by.
description_expanded: Reviews(4)Leave a ReviewOverall:July 2024Second stay!The Gulf Place townhouse is perfect! Inside it is very spacious, comfortable, and extremely clean! It has everything you need during your stay and plenty of room for many people. The beds are very comfortable. And the location is excellent! Super close to several great restaurants & shops, and an easy walk to the beach. One of the community pools is a few steps away too. This was are second time at this property and we will definitely stay here again. Sandpiper Vacations were great to rent from as well, great communication!Overall:June 2025Had a wonderful stayWe had a wonderful stay at Shore To Please (now called Sea-Renity-Now!) at Gulf Place. We are snow birds and have already booked Shore To Please for next winter. The unit is spacious, clean and well decorated and felt like home. The pool that was close to us heated and in a quiet, less windy area so it was comfortable to swim or sit and read, even on the colder days. We were able to play pickleball on the tennis court and the other tennis court was in the process of being converted to 3 pickleball courts. Gulf Place has several good restaurants in the complex and close by so we walked to most places that we ate. We were connected to Shore To Please through Sandpiper Vacation Rentals who were wonderful from the time of booking through leaving. They responded quickly and we felt well informed and in good hands.
